variant.author: AlmondCookie
variant.changelog:
修复 DLL 混淆导致庭具导出为空的问题；院子扫描覆盖 600 个对象槽位；读取失败或手动导出读到 0 件家具时取消保存；新增批量染色预检、库存核对与停止操作。

Fix outdoor export broken by DLL obfuscation; scan all 600 outdoor object slots; cancel saving after read failures or when manual export reads no furniture; add batch dye preflight, inventory checks, and stop controls.
